The Process

How Car Shipping Works

From quote to delivery, here's what to expect when you ship a car with us.

Step 1

Request a Quote

Tell us where the vehicle is, where it's going, and when. We'll send you an all-in price. Book when you're ready — there's no deposit required to get a quote.

Step 2

We Assign a Carrier

We match your route with a vetted, insured carrier and schedule a pickup window at your door. You'll get the driver's contact information before pickup.

Step 3

Pickup and Delivery

The driver inspects the vehicle with you at pickup, and again at delivery. Do a walkaround, sign the bill of lading, and you're done.

Questions

Car Shipping FAQ

How much does car shipping cost?
Car shipping cost depends on distance, vehicle size, transport type (open or enclosed), and how quickly you need pickup. Busy lanes like Florida to New York or Texas to California often cost less per mile than out-of-the-way routes. Request a quote for an exact all-in number — it won't change after you book.
How long does auto transport take?
Regional car shipping usually delivers within a few days. Coast-to-coast auto transport typically takes 7–10 days. Once your vehicle is dispatched, we give you an estimated delivery window and keep you posted along the way.
Is my vehicle insured during transport?
Yes. Every carrier we work with holds active cargo insurance, and your vehicle is covered the entire time it's on the truck. We can share the coverage details before you book.
Should I choose open or enclosed car shipping?
Open is the standard and works fine for everyday vehicles — it's how dealerships move new cars. Choose enclosed if the vehicle is a classic, exotic, or high-value car, or if it sits low enough that loading ramps are a concern.
Can you ship a car that doesn't run?
Yes. Just tell us when you book so we assign a carrier with a winch or the right equipment to load it.
What should I do before pickup?
Remove personal items, leave about a quarter tank of fuel, and take photos of any existing damage. The driver will do a full inspection with you at pickup and again at delivery.
